profile: ANI Pharmaceuticals develops, manufactures, and commercializes therapeutics through its Rare Disease, Generics, and Brands businesses. Its products include ILUVIEN for diabetic macular edema and chronic non-infectious uveitis affecting the posterior segment of the eye, as well as a broad generics portfolio spanning varied indications. The company operates pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities capable of producing oral solid dose products, semi-solids, liquids, topicals, controlled substances, and potent products.
